{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
